primary_question: Does the successful full-space causal direction retain behavioral control when projected into the selected tracking subspace?
secondary_question: How much dimensionality is needed to recover full-space control under tracking, random and coordinate reconstructions?
limitations: Uses saved full-space vectors from the completed convergence development pilot; it does not optimize new low-rank interventions.
Eight development examples and one model/task are diagnostic only, not population evidence.
Tracking projection failure would show insufficiency of this selected SVD subspace for these saved full vectors, not impossibility of all low-rank causal control.
Random and coordinate controls are descriptive controls; optimized behavior subspaces remain a subsequent protocol.
No test examples are evaluated and no frozen study result is modified.
